# FG-INT-0019

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | [`integrations`](../../ops/runbooks/integrations.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `manual_links_past_the_limit_are_int_0019` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このマージリクエストに手動でリンクできる作業項目の上限に達しました。要らないリンクを外してから、もう一度試してください。
- en: This merge request has the maximum number of manually linked work items. Unlink one it no longer needs, then try again.
- id: Permintaan merge ini sudah memiliki jumlah maksimum item kerja yang ditautkan secara manual. Lepaskan tautan yang tidak diperlukan, lalu coba lagi.

## 原因 (cause)

`PUT /api/v1/projects/{id}/merge-requests/{iid}/work-items/{ref}` would give a merge request a 51st open manual link (forge-db `work_items::MAX_MANUAL_LINKS`; detected links are bounded separately at 20). Counted under the merge request's row lock. Nothing was written.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason=manual_link_limit`, `limit` (50), `project_id` and `merge_request_id`, with `action=WorkItemLink`. `GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/merge-requests/{iid}/work-items` lists the links (`unlinked_at` null = open, `source` manual / auto).

## 対処 (fix)

Unlink work items the merge request no longer needs (`DELETE …/work-items/{ref}`), or split the change into several merge requests. The limit is fixed in code.
